name: dpaternina/filter-pills
title: Category pills
description: The site's categories as the design's pills — real links to real archives, which is what makes them work with JavaScript switched off. Two variations: the filter row that leads with an All pill, and the archive band that prints each category's count.

variations.name: filter
variations.title: Category pills — filter row
variations.description: The blog index's filter. Leads with an All pill pointing at the posts index, and prints no counts.

variations.name: band
variations.title: Category pills — other categories
variations.description: The band under a category archive. Prints each category's count, and the archive you are already on is not offered.
